items.title: Ed Allen Interview, 1961-01-14
items.q: But the same band go back under Fayette Mariv was named.

ctx.x: would say that you played with that played what you could call jazz? Well this band, I can say this ten piece band. That was about the first one.

It was a real good band, real music. We had bands all over the country, because I remember what was going on. We just didn't have sense enough to procter by. We broke up the band, and we just didn't have the band. We broke up. How long did the band stay together? About two years. In fact, during the two summers, I was with Captain Joe, and demanded more money for the band. But as usual, that amount of money at that time was a lot of money for average musician, and he used to make that kind of money. So he didn't…
Oh, right in New Orleans? Yeah.
